P1.reason: A keeps pawn movement (forward, straight, diagonal, capture) as one clean rule and board update separate; B blends legality, setup and mobility into larger mixed groups.

differences.reason: Helps: board update plus initial setup, without duplicating legal-move statements already in C4.
Helps: forward direction with straight, diagonal and capture moves forms a coherent pawn-movement rule.
Hurts: mixes legal-move rules with board update and initial setup, duplicating C4 content.
Hurts: adds opponent, occupancy and mobility (end-condition helpers) to movement, blurring the movement rule.
